body: MAINLINE-011 P3-FRAME filed. At the float-mass ceiling the least limit is member yield everywhere in the P3 design space: 6061-T6 best SF 0.2331 at s=3.0 m, r_o=86.6 mm, t_w=2.25 mm (Euler tied 0.2333, local 0.908, film 0.838), a flat plateau 0.2319-0.2333 across s 1-3 m. Geometry buys nothing past the wall; the pinned r_o=0.02 frame (005's P3-A, reproduced) is Euler-bound at 0.096, so freeing the radius doubles it to 0.233. Best P3 equals P2-E's 0.2339 at kd 0.2 and beats P2-E at 004's curve kd 0.1407 (0.1646) by 1.42x; P3's member limits carry no spherical knockdown. Equal-mass tube swap: CFRP T700 QI 0.765 (best CFRP; rank flips vs 008's P2-E where M55J led - P3 is sigma/rho-bound), M55J 0.487, K13D2U 0.287; SiC (008 rank 1) 2.85 with the film the second limit (2.86 at s=0.88, binding from s=1); CNT-yarn projection 1.95. The material gap closes for P3 first: a tube material at sigma/rho about 3.3x aluminum already passes SF 1 at the ceiling. Exact annulus sections answer 005's thin-wall flag (t_w/r_o 0.019-0.076 at optima). Cross-checks 10/10 against 005, 004, 008 and the pins. All QUESTIONABLE; global-mode, local-knockdown, SiC and film objections in NFI.
